content: confluent-kafka-python 2.15.0 recommended over aiokafka 0.14.0 for production: built on librdkafka C library, higher throughput, first-class Avro/Protobuf Schema Registry integration, transactional producers. Async story: use AsyncIO Producer/AIOProducer for producing; for consuming, wrap blocking consumer.poll() in loop.run_in_executor since native asyncio consumer support is still community-debated (GitHub issue #1723 open, no definitive resolution).
